name: open-agent
description: An open-source, self-hosted, provider-agnostic AI agent runtime.

scripts.typecheck: for p in context agent automation memory providers registry security tools-mcp tools-browser tools-computer tools-decision tools-files tools-http tools-search tools-terminal tools-git tools-todo tools-vision; do npx tsc -p packages/$p/tsconfig.json --noEmit || exit 1; done; npx tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p apps/web/src/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:scripts
scripts.web: npm run build --workspace @open-agent/web && npm run start --workspace @open-agent/cli -- web
